outlook.statement: Your company will continue to focus its efforts to increase its activities under fee-based business in addition to concentrating on recovery of over dues and reduction of Non-Performing Assets, disinvestment of quoted and unquoted investments. Your company's involved management network, satisfied clientele, quality manpower and diligent internal control and cost control measures will enable your company to continue to report better performance in the coming years.

Company will continue to focus on increasing fee-based business activities, recovery of overdues, reduction of Non Performing Assets, and disinvestment of quoted and unquoted investments. Management network, satisfied clientele, quality manpower, profitable expansion, and diligent internal control and cost control measures will enable better performance in coming years.
